description: The figurative constant ALL literal-1 with a literal-1 longer than one character ASSOCIATED with a numeric or numeric-edited item - moved to it (the written MOVE, an implicit FROM/INTO move, INITIALIZE REPLACING's hypothetical MOVE) or compared with it (IF / EVALUATE / PERFORM UNTIL / SEARCH WHEN) - prohibited by ISO §2023:8.3.3.6.3 SR3. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.2 admits it as an obsolete element, 'Associating the figurative constant ALL literal where the length of the literal is greater than one with a data item that is numeric or numeric edited is an obsolete feature in Standard COBOL' (§1985:p.XVII-82 item 2: it 'has been placed in the obsolete element category'); §2002:F.1 item 1 removes it with the rest of that list, 'ALL literal and numeric or numeric edited item (association of a multi-character ALL literal with a numeric or numeric-edited data item)', and §2002:8.3.1.2.5.2 SR3 states the bar, 'If the length of literal-1 is greater than one, it is not permitted to be associated with a numeric or numeric-edited item', which §2014:8.3.1.2.5.2 SR3 and §2023:8.3.3.6.3 SR3 print word for word (VCR Table 7 row 7.13). Accepted at 85 with the 8.3.3.6.4 GR2 repeat-and-truncate value (ALL "57" -> PIC 9(3) = 575), 0902 at 2002+ (warning under --permissive, value preserved). One predicate: FigurativeAssociation (kb/Work PB422); askers VersionConformancePass.GateSr5 and StatementValidation.CheckRelationalOperands.
display: a multi-character ALL literal associated with a numeric or numeric-edited item
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. MVALLM.
DATA DIVISION.

01 W-INT PIC 9(3).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.

    DISPLAY W-INT.
